author: Lintuxer
tagline: Login admin / change-me-asap — Soulseek client with a web UI
description:
**Sign in as `admin` / `change-me-asap`** and change it. That password and
the shipped `SLSKD_API_KEY` are placeholders every install from this store
shares — the API key is an **administrator** key, so replace both in the
compose (Advanced → environment) before you expose port 5030.

Then add your own Soulseek account under **System → Options**. It is not in
this package on purpose: Soulseek has no registration site, an unused name
is claimed on first login, and a made-up account would be a lie the app
cannot use.

A modern client-server application for the Soulseek file sharing network,
with a web UI and an API. Runs headless, downloads into /DATA/Downloads —
the folder SoulSync reads — and pairs with SoulSync as its download
backend. Sharing is switched OFF here by design; your music library is
mounted read-only, and you decide whether to share it.
title: slskd
